## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run test` passes; new behaviour has tests
- [ ] Generated files were regenerated (`bun run tokens`), not hand-edited
- [ ] UI changes: screenshots in **Polar Night** and **Snow Storm**, keyboard + focus checked
- [ ] New dependencies are pinned in the catalog / `[workspace.dependencies]` at the latest stable version
- [ ] Tauri capabilities / IPC changes are least-privilege and reviewed
- [ ] Docs updated (`other/documents/`, `CLAUDE.md`, rules) if behaviour or commands changed
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`type(scope): subject`)
